observations: All 12 samples show coherent knee anatomy within each stated plane. No gross blank matrix, wrong body part, mirrored mixed-knee field or conspicuous decoding failure is evident in these samples.
Series 401 and 501 show corresponding sagittal positions with different visible contrast. They cannot be called duplicate pixel series from repeated geometry alone.
Four series provide axial, coronal and sagittal coverage; such coverage neither dates the examination nor proves both original and recall series are present.

Metadata records 130 source slices, four series, eight endpoint headers, one hashed patient identifier, four frame-of-reference hashes, blank literal side/time fields and placeholder descriptions. Acquisition numbers 2..5 and series numbers 201..501 do not map them to the two report sections. Multiple frame identifiers are not evidence of separate patients or dates.

independent_recommendation_before_propos.correspondence: exclude whole-study non-gold report supervision while the initial/recall linkage remains unresolved; this is a conservative report-to-image eligibility action, not a declaration that the images contradict the report

Since the current policy mechanism is whole-study correspondence masking, preserving the aggregate report while masking its non-gold loss avoids unsupported temporal binding.
independent_recommendation_before_propos.image_handling: retain all four cache series and source images; no quality exclusion supported by these 12 samples
independent_recommendation_before_propos.gold: preserve official gold and its evaluation masks; no gold values read

No inference that the four series are recall-only, initial-only, or two separate image examinations.
